name: posing_close
prompt: Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print. Bold black key lines of varied weight around every form, flat colour with no gradients on the creature, a limited palette of deep indigo sea, cream paper and brick red, pattern lines instead of shading, cream claw-shaped foam where it breaks the water. The subject is a colossal brick-red fiddler crab, low in the water, carrying a small mossy green island with stone cliffs on its back, one gigantic vermilion claw and one tiny claw, and two tall thick eyestalks ending in big round cream-white eyes with black pupils and heavy dark eyelids, the left eye a little lower and smaller than the right. Its expression is vain and posing: chin up, eyelids half lowered in smug disdain, pupils turned sideways toward the viewer, one eyestalk cocked higher than the other, a small smirk. Extreme close-up of its face and eyestalks seen from the front and a little above, filling the picture, a plain indigo sea behind.
